data.name: Term_ReducedRate
data.value: The lower rate a small company pays on a first slice of its taxable income. From its fifth tax period, it keeps it only if a director's pay reaches a minimum, or its taxable income does not exceed that pay. In every tax period, it loses it once benefits in kind valued at a flat rate, such as a company car's, exceed {0} of that pay, the benefits included.
